title: AEW coordination message
description: F9-A (ADR-0017; plan v4 D-1 to D-12): one Lead-worker coordination message, a line of its invocation's append-only thread (.aew/work/<T>/coordination/<INV>.jsonl). A message moves knowledge, never project state: recording it commits nothing, and no gate, transition or dispatch reads it.

thread.description: The invocation whose thread this is (D-1: one thread per invocation).

ticket_revision.description: The Ticket revision the invocation records on an F4-enabled project; null on a dormant project or a non-Ticket unit (D-9).

run.description: The thread invocation's latest harness run when the message was recorded; null before any run.

in_reply_to.description: An earlier message of the same thread; a worker message always names a Lead message (D-10).

idempotency_id.description: Scoped to (sender, thread). An explicit id, or sha256: of the canonical JSON of [sender, thread, in_reply_to, kind, body, refs] when the sender gave none (D-8).

refs.description: kind:value strings (D-12). A ref grants no access and is never resolved for the recipient.

checked_rev.description: The control revision the message was recorded against: for a Lead message, the expect_rev it was checked against (D-4).
